info.title: Properties API
info.description: Public properties and foreclosure listings API

get.description: Returns a paginated list of public, live properties (listings and foreclosures). Use `polymorphic_type=listing` or `polymorphic_type=foreclosure` to restrict to a single type. Supports `page` and `page_size` (default 100, max 300).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number within the paginated result set.

parameters.name: polymorphic_type
parameters.description: Restrict results to a single property type.

parameters.name: listing_types
parameters.description: Filter by multiple listing types. Comma-separated.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Filter by specific property IDs. Multiple values may be separated by commas.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude of center point. Use with `lng` and `radius_km`.

parameters.name: lng
parameters.description: Longitude of center point. Use with `lat` and `radius_km`.

parameters.name: radius_km
parameters.description: Search radius in kilometers. Use with `lat` and `lng`.

parameters.name: polygon
parameters.description: Comma-separated `lng lat` pairs forming a closed polygon.

get.description: Searches for a parcel using its KAEK (cadastral) code. Requires a valid Bearer token.
Retrieves aggregated Census 2021 data for all buildings in a building block, identified by geographical code and building block. Requires a valid Bearer token.

parameters.name: dataset
parameters.description: Census 2021 dataset to query. Currently only `building_and_characteristics` is supported.

parameters.name: geographical_code
parameters.description: Geographical code identifying the area (e.g. quarter/village code).

parameters.name: building_block
parameters.description: Building block number within the geographical area.

200.description: Every field of the matched record is returned as a flat JSON object. Response shape depends on the requested dataset.

404.description: No record found for the given dataset, geographical code and building block.

example.error: No Census 2021 'building_and_characteristics' record found for geographical_code='0123' and building_block='045'.

get.description: Calculates the as-new reconstruction cost of a property from its postal-code prefix, property type, and build area. If a construction year is supplied, the as-is (depreciated) value is also returned.

parameters.name: postal_code
parameters.description: Full postal code. Only the first two digits are used for the cost lookup. Numeric, at least two digits.

parameters.name: build_area
parameters.description: Build area in m². Must be greater than 0.

parameters.name: construction_year
parameters.description: Construction year. When provided, the response also includes the as-is (depreciated) value. Cannot be in the future.

422.description: No reconstruction cost mapping exists for the given postal-code prefix and property type.

post.summary: List points of interest near a coordinate
post.description: Returns nearby points of interest (POIs) for an arbitrary latitude/longitude pair, using the same selection logic as the Marketability Report neighbourhood section: up to 16 POIs, at most 3 per place type, with per-category search radii (airport 10 km; metro, tram, train and future metro 2 km; everything else 1 km), ordered nearest-first. Although the operation is a read with no side effects, coordinates are passed in a JSON request body, so the endpoint uses POST. The route requires the trailing slash — a redirected slashless POST can drop its body in some clients.

200.description: Points of interest near the queried coordinate, ordered nearest-first. An empty array means nothing is within range — not an error.

400.description: Missing `latitude`/`longitude`, out-of-range value, or non-numeric value.

distance.description: Distance from the queried point, in metres, rounded to 2 decimals.

kaek.description: KAEK (parcel) code. Only populated when `kaek=true` and a parcel matches. Otherwise `null`.

geometry.description: Parcel geometry as a GeoJSON string.

as_is.description: As-is (depreciated) value. Only present when `construction_year` was supplied.
